scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.db: docker compose stop api web && docker compose up -d --wait db
scripts.dev: npm run db && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix api run dev" "npm --prefix web start"
scripts.dev:api: npm run db && npm --prefix api run dev
scripts.test: docker compose --profile test up -d --wait db-test && npm --prefix api test
